description: PAID, per data point, USDC on Base via x402: score $0.05 (the risk band Conservative / Moderate / Speculative and 0-100 composite), market $0.02 (the venue's current APY, TVL, basis and measured_at, refreshed hourly), index $0.05 (the TVL-weighted SYRI market index across every venue on sale). Choose any with `data`; the default is score and market together. Called without payment, this returns the payment terms for the chosen points rather than the data — that is the expected first response, not a failure. If you can settle x402 payments, pass the encoded authorization as x_payment to receive them.

data.description: Data points to buy: any of score, market, index. Default ["score", "market"]. Priced per point and summed.

entity.description: Venue slug, token, protocol or alias — e.g. usdc-aave-v3, ousg, sdai, usde.

x_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 payment authorization (sent as Payment-Signature).

name: get_syri_score
title: Get the SYRI risk score for a venue (paid)
